description:
The Subscriber path's slot state `{:subscribed, server, raw}` (hooks.ex ~267) lets `resolve_value/5` (~299) detect when the resolved server changed across renders and trigger `maybe_remove_projection` + new subscribe. The Cell slot `{:cell_subscribed, raw}` (~391) has no identity to compare against, so dynamic cell-swap on rerender silently fails.

Change slot to `{:cell_subscribed, cell, raw}` and update `use_cell_subscribed`, `resolve_cell_value`, and any place that pattern-matches on the slot tag (grep for `:cell_subscribed`). Add a test that swaps the cell value across renders and asserts the old subscription is removed and a new one is established.

Alternative if Q1 lands as (b) and we prefer Cell to stay totally identity-free: document explicitly that `use_cell` does not support a changing cell across renders. Pick one — don't leave it ambiguous.
title: Slot tag carries cell identity for swap detection
